require 'webrick'
require 'json'
require 'fileutils'
require 'timeout'

module CircuitBreaker
  STATES = [:closed, :open, :half_open].freeze
  
  class Breaker
    attr_reader :state, :failure_count, :last_failure_time
    
    def initialize(threshold: 5, timeout: 30)
      @state = :closed
      @failure_count = 0
      @threshold = threshold
      @timeout = timeout
      @last_failure_time = nil
      @mutex = Mutex.new
    end
    
    def call(&block)
      case @state
      when :open
        if Time.now - @last_failure_time >= @timeout
          @mutex.synchronize { @state = :half_open }
          try_request(&block)
        else
          raise "Circuit open - service unavailable"
        end
      when :closed, :half_open
        try_request(&block)
      end
    end
    
    private
    
    def try_request(&block)
      result = block.call
      @mutex.synchronize do
        @failure_count = 0
        @state = :closed
      end
      result
    rescue => e
      record_failure
      raise e
    end
    
    def record_failure
      @mutex.synchronize do
        @failure_count += 1
        @last_failure_time = Time.now
        if @failure_count >= @threshold
          @state = :open
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

class TemplateRenderer
  TEMPLATE_DIR = File.expand_path('../templates', __FILE__)
  
  def initialize
    FileUtils.mkdir_p(TEMPLATE_DIR)
    @cache = {}
  end
  
  def render(template_name, context = {})
    content = load_template(template_name)
    process_directives(content, context)
  end
  
  private
  
  def load_template(name)
    return @cache[name] if @cache.key?(name)
    safe_name = sanitize_filename(name)
    path = File.join(TEMPLATE_DIR, safe_name)
    raise "Template not found: #{safe_name}" unless File.exist?(path)
    @cache[name] = File.read(path)
  end
  
  def sanitize_filename(name)
    # Remove path traversal attempts
    basename = File.basename(name)
    basename.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/, '')
  end
  
  def process_directives(content, context)
    # Process variable substitutions: {{variable}}
    result = content.gsub(/\{\{(\w+)\}\}/) do |match|
      key = $1.to_sym
      context.fetch(key, match)
    end
    
    # Process include directives for composability
    result = process_includes(result, context)
    result
  end
  
  def process_includes(content, context)
    # Handle <!--#include virtual="path" --> style directives
    content.gsub(/<!--#include\s+virtual="([^"]+)"\s*-->/) do |match|
      include_path = $1
      resolve_include(include_path, context)
    end
  end
  
  def resolve_include(path, context)
    # Resolve the include path relative to template directory only
    resolved = File.expand_path(path, TEMPLATE_DIR)
    
    if File.exist?(resolved) && file_within_root?(resolved)
      File.read(resolved)
    else
      "<!-- include error: not found -->"
    end
  end
  
  def file_within_root?(path)
    # Verify file is within template directory
    expanded = File.expand_path(path)
    expanded.start_with?(TEMPLATE_DIR)
  end
end

class APIServer
  def initialize(port: 8080)
    @port = port
    @breaker = CircuitBreaker::Breaker.new(threshold: 3, timeout: 15)
    @renderer = TemplateRenderer.new
    @server = WEBrick::HTTPServer.new(Port: @port, Logger: WEBrick::Log.new("/dev/null"))
    setup_routes
  end
  
  def start
    trap('INT') { @server.shutdown }
    @server.start
  end
  
  private
  
  def setup_routes
    @server.mount_proc '/api/v1/render' do |req, res|
      handle_render(req, res)
    end
    
    @server.mount_proc '/api/v1/status' do |req, res|
      handle_status(req, res)
    end
    
    @server.mount_proc '/api/v1/health' do |req, res|
      handle_health(req, res)
    end
  end
  
  def handle_render(req, res)
    unless req.request_method == 'POST'
      return error_response(res, 405, 'Method not allowed')
    end
    
    begin
      body = JSON.parse(req.body)
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      return error_response(res, 400, 'Invalid JSON')
    end
    
    template = body['template']
    context = body.fetch('context', {})
    user_content = body.fetch('content', '')
    
    unless template.is_a?(String) && template.length > 0
      return error_response(res, 400, 'Missing template parameter')
    end
    
    begin
      result = @breaker.call do
        # Build context with user-provided content - sanitize before inclusion
        render_context = symbolize_keys(context)
        render_context[:user_content] = sanitize_user_content(user_content)
        @renderer.render(template, render_context)
      end
      
      res.status = 200
      res['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
      res.body = JSON.generate({ result: result, status: 'ok' })
    rescue RuntimeError => e
      if e.message.include?('Circuit open')
        error_response(res, 503, 'Service temporarily unavailable')
      else
        error_response(res, 500, 'Internal error')
      end
    end
  end
  
  def handle_status(req, res)
    res.status = 200
    res['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
    res.body = JSON.generate({
      circuit_state: @breaker.state,
      failure_count: @breaker.failure_count
    })
  end
  
  def handle_health(req, res)
    res.status = 200
    res['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
    res.body = JSON.generate({ status: 'healthy', timestamp: Time.now.iso8601 })
  end
  
  def sanitize_user_content(content)
    return '' unless content.is_a?(String)
    # Escape all HTML special characters and strip SSI directives completely
    sanitized = content.gsub(/&/, '&').gsub(/</, '<').gsub(/>/, '>')
    sanitized.gsub(/<!--/, '').gsub(/-->/, '')
  end
  
  def symbolize_keys(hash)
    hash.each_with_object({}) { |(k, v), h| h[k.to_sym] = v }
  end
  
  def error_response(res, code, message)
    res.status = code
    res['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
    res.body = JSON.generate({ error: message, status: 'error' })
  end
end

if __FILE__ == $0
  server = APIServer.new(port: ENV.fetch('PORT', 8080).to_i)
  server.start
end
